subject: Hosted evaluation: eligibility snapshot & next actions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@novaretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted evaluation: eligibility snapshot & next actions

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what you and Bryan raised on the call:

Summary of needs we heard
- Target workload: ~1.2M tokens/day, ~100 concurrent end users during peak (mostly short prompts ~40–60 tokens, responses typically ~80 tokens).
- Primary preference: Hosted API for rapid time-to-value, but must understand throughput guarantees and data controls (VPC or dedicated capacity) if we need stricter isolation.
- Security/compliance: your security team asked for a short questionnaire and example logs/audit screenshots.

What Redwood can offer for an evaluation
- Hosted API pilot: sandbox endpoints, tenant-scoped keys, token-level usage reporting, 2-week traffic slice with configurable rate caps. Fastest to get started (typical provisioning: 1–3 business days).
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool for sustained throughput and stronger isolation. Recommended when steady-state throughput exceeds ~1M tokens/day with tight latency SLOs.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): available for regulated flows — longer lead time (multi-week), requires network onboarding and a private control plane.

Immediate asks/action items I need from you
1) Confirm pilot preference: Hosted sandbox pilot vs start with Dedicated evaluation.
2) Ops contact: please confirm who on your side (Bryan?) will take the security questionnaire and handle sandbox egress rules.
3) Traffic sample: one or two example payloads (prompt + expected response length) to size rate cap & KV cache recommendation.

Proposed next steps (if you want to try Hosted sandbox)
- We spin up a sandbox tenant and provide credentials + per-route endpoints (same API, scoped key).
- Default trial rate caps: 150 requests/sec total, token ceiling 2.5M/day (can be adjusted after the first 48 hrs).
- Recommended pilot length: 2 weeks with a 48–72 hour smoke window to tune batching and prefix caching.

Attachments: novaretail_security_questions.pdf (for Bryan/security team)

I'll loop in Monica (ops) and Karthik (runtime) to flesh out endpoint mapping and rate recommendations once you confirm the pilot path.

Would you like us to provision the sandbox tomorrow so you can start internal smoke tests on Monday?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@novaretail.com>

Cc: Bryan Lee <bryan@novaretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: eligibility snapshot & next actions

Jordan —

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Our security team is open to a Hosted sandbox but will want to see the security questionnaire and example audit logs. I attached the list of items they typically ask for (see novaretail_security_questions.pdf).
- If the Hosted sandbox can demonstrate steady throughput without noisy neighbors and we can get token-level logs and retention settings, that will suffice for a first pilot.
- Bryan (cc'd) is our infrastructure lead — he'll need the egress IPs for sandbox endpoints and any guidance for limiting outbound traffic during the trial.

We can provide two sample request patterns by end of day: search-assist short prompts and a few multi-turn flows.

Can you include an estimate for expected 95th percentile latency at your default rate caps? We need to make sure interactive experience stays under ~350ms token latency.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product | Novaretail
agomez@novaretail.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@novaretail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T18:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: eligibility snapshot & next actions

Hi Alicia/Bryan —

Thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the security checklist. Short answers to your asks and a recommended pilot configuration:

Security & audit
- We can supply sanitized sample audit logs (request id, timestamp, model variant, tokens in/out) and screenshots of the Console retention settings.
- The questionnaire you attached is a perfect starting point; we'll return a completed PDF plus a short supplement with our SOC 2 scope and KMS integration notes.

Trial performance guidance
- Default Hosted sandbox config: 150 rps total, token ceiling 2.5M/day. For your traffic shape (short prompts + short responses) we estimate typical per-token latency in the 80–120ms range for generation (end-to-end token time under 300–350ms for your 40–80 token responses) under the default rate cap, assuming no heavy background KV-cache misses.
- If you push sustained throughput beyond ~1M tokens/day with strict <200ms gen latency needs, Dedicated capacity is recommended; it reduces noisy neighbor variance and gives predictable kernel mapping.

Ops/runbook items (what we will do)
1) Provision sandbox tenant + scoped API keys (1 business day). Attachment: redwood_sandbox-instructions.txt (includes example curl, endpoint URLs, and egress IP list).
2) Provide a short-run checklist for prefix caching hints and batching knobs for your engineers to test.
3) Set up a 30-minute kickoff with Jordan, Bryan, and Karthik to walk through endpoint mapping and sample payloads.

Next steps we propose
- Jordan: confirm pilot start date.
- Alicia/Bryan: share two representative payloads and confirm Bryan is the ops contact for firewall/egress.
- We'll return the completed security questionnaire within 48 hours.

If helpful, Karthik can outline a Dedicated capacity delta (rough order of magnitude for cost and provisioning lead time) in the kickoff.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
